normalized.description: The objective of this study is to produce a gap analysis of where commercial data and Copernicus capabilities can be complementary for high-cadence monitoring for the EU Green Deal. The study should aim at understanding better and exploring how commercial data sets can bring potentially strong complementarities to Copernicus in view of the implementation of the 2030 Biodiversity and Farm to Fork strategies and the planned Forest strategy.
